Subject: Webinar export + replay (Cost vs. Latency) — suggested routing

Team — attaching the attendee export and slides from today's webinar ("Cost vs. Latency: Serving LLMs at Scale"). Replay is live here: https://redwood.app/replay/2027-04-25-cost-vs-latency.

Quick summary / ask:
- Export: finlytics_attendee_export_20270425.csv (attached). It includes: attendance flag, company, title, total tokens estimate, demo request flag, and Q&A notes.
- Recommend quick MQL buckets (we auto-tagged in the file):
  * Hot — attended + demo_request = true OR product-question in Q&A + company_size >= 50
  * Warm — attended but no demo request, engaged in poll
  * Cold — registered but did not attend

Action items:
1) SDR claim: Hot list should be claimed first thing — please use the Attendee Claims sheet (link below) to claim by ACCT (col A). We expect ~18 hot rows.
2) Outreach: Use the two-button templates in the shared Drive (quick intro + replay + CTA).
3) Reporting: Please mark claim status in HubSpot by EOD PST — I linked the company records in the related links.

Attachments: finlytics_attendee_export_20270425.csv, webinar_slides_cost_vs_latency.pdf

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
